meta.title: Seasons Around the World — Vocabulary Set 5
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Challenge quiz on word families, antonyms, synonyms, and parts of speech for 'Seasons Around the World'.

questions.question: Which of these is the opposite (antonym) of 'Northern'?
questions.explanation: 'Southern' refers to south, which is the direct opposite direction of 'Northern' (north).

questions.question: 'Hibernate' is a verb, and 'hibernation' is its noun form.
questions.explanation: True. 'Hibernate' describes the action, and 'hibernation' is the state of deep winter sleep (noun).

questions.question: Which of these words is the opposite of the adjective 'dry'?
questions.explanation: 'Wet' means covered with water or rain, making it the opposite of 'dry' (having no water).

questions.question: The words 'die' and 'live' are synonyms.
questions.explanation: False. 'Die' (stop living) and 'live' (be alive) are antonyms, not synonyms.

questions.question: Which of these words is a noun (naming word)?
questions.explanation: 'Sunlight' is a noun because it is the name of a thing (the light of the sun). The others are verbs or adjectives.

questions.question: The antonym of 'appear' (meaning to go out of sight) is _______.
In the phrase 'the coldest place,' what part of speech is 'coldest'?
questions.explanation: 'Coldest' is an adjective because it describes the noun 'place' (what kind of place it is).

questions.question: Sort these words into Verbs (actions) or Nouns (places/things):
questions.explanation: 'Hibernate' and 'appear' are actions (verbs). 'Snow,' 'rain,' and 'equator' are naming words (nouns).

questions.question: 'Darkness' is the noun form of the adjective 'dark.'
questions.explanation: True. Adding the suffix '-ness' to 'dark' changes it from an adjective to a noun.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe wet weather:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'The weather was very rainy.' Here, 'rainy' is an adjective describing 'weather.'

questions.question: In 'It can rain a lot during spring,' what part of speech is 'rain'?
questions.explanation: Here, 'rain' acts as a verb (it is something that happens: 'can rain').

questions.question: The opposite (antonym) of the adjective 'dark' is _______.
Arrange the words to describe the poles:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'South Pole is opposite of North Pole.' They are at opposite ends of the Earth.

questions.question: In the text 'near the equator,' the word 'equator' is a proper noun and must be capitalized.
questions.explanation: False. In English, 'equator' is usually a common noun and is lowercase unless starting a sentence.

questions.question: Which word family includes the word 'weather'?
questions.explanation: Both options contain words in the 'weather' word family, representing verb forms and compound adjectives.
